cards.prompt: Which nuts are in our homemade granola? Pick all that apply.
cards.explanation: Our homemade granola is made with oats, flour, linseed, walnuts, almonds, hazelnuts and honey. It's in the Signature Granola, the Greek Yoghurt Crème and the Tropical Açaí Bowl.
cards.why: Granola appears in several dishes, so a nut allergy affects all of them.
